description: This file defines the IndexingContentHandler class, which manages content indexing events such as creation, update, removal, and publishing within the OrchardCore CMS. It handles deferred indexing tasks, interacts with index profiles, and manages content item indexing and deletion.

classes.name: IndexingContentHandler
classes.description: Handles content indexing events, manages deferred indexing tasks, and interacts with index profiles and content items for indexing and deletion.

methods.name: PublishedAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when content is published, adds the content item for indexing.

methods.name: CreatedAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when content is created, adds the content item for indexing.

methods.name: UpdatedAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when content is updated, adds the content item for indexing.

methods.name: RemovedAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when content is removed, marks the content item for removal from index.

methods.name: DraftSavedAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when a draft is saved, adds the content item for indexing.

methods.name: UnpublishedAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when content is unpublished, adds the content item for indexing.

methods.name: RemovedContentItemAsync
methods.description: Marks a content item for removal from index if it has a valid ID.

methods.name: AddContentItemAsync
methods.description: Adds a content item to the indexing queue if it is not a preview and has a valid ID.

methods.name: AddDeferredTask
methods.description: Schedules the deferred indexing task if not already scheduled.

methods.name: IndexAsync
methods.description: Performs the actual indexing or removal of content items based on the current scope, interacting with index profiles and content managers.
